### ① Contract against the card and the rulings

- The maintainer's word, verbatim on the card and transcribed in 6721331178: 「同意开 AI 评测 车道」. The diff charters the standing laneless `eval` lane (`eval#N`), registers it in the SKILL.md 〈域车道〉 row beside `security` · `review`, and adds the `eval` seat word where the `qa` precedent (#31333) added `qa`: `SEAT_BARE_LANES`, `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE`, the project seat-word line. No routine is created, no seat is opened, nothing publishes (`skip-changeset`). ✓
- Letter B (6184799323 item 1): a ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file authorizes raising that file's ceiling by the measured delta, quoted in the PR body. 6721331178 names `references/lanes/eval.md` and the SKILL.md registration as its workload; the PR body quotes the id and the delta (eval.md 0 → 45, new row at the landed count, headroom 0; SKILL.md 319 → 319; project-forms 59 → 59; no other row moves). The raise is in form. ✓
- Surface: the three `.claude/**` files of the claim plus the three `scripts/pm` files the seat's amendments 6721478410 / 6721488309 added, each with its measured reason (the ratchet's lane-roster self-test reds on a charter with no ceiling row; without the lane words `eval#1` could neither sign nor open a mailbox). Six files, matching the report. ✓

### ② The charter against the card's draft (point 1)

- Read side by side, every rule of 〈车道章程草案〉 is present: 座位与唤醒 (seat and chief, signature / seat post / mailbox as other seats, no `domain:*`, cadence set by the maintainer in Routines, the seat builds and changes none, the suggested cadence kept as 建议); 评测范围 ①–④ in the card's order and substance; 成本规则 (subscription by default under the maintainer's cost principle, ②③ on API only inside an approved budget, model and spend recorded each round, three-week readings to the seat post); 产出 (one scorecard per round with the trend, defects through the filing gate to the owning lane, scoring errors to the scorer's maintainer); 边界 (no `os-dev`, no product code, no PR; skill text to `domain:skills` via `finding`; leaks only per `security-findings.md`, scorecards say "有泄露" and never the content; no external accuracy numbers); 地盘 (both repositories, cloud code changes still through the owning lane); 交接 (all four hand-overs).
- The one addition is 「无 `pm:queue`」 on L6, the same words `qa.md` L6 carries for the other laneless Routine seat; a seat with no `domain:*` label has no queue to read, so it states the card's premise rather than a new rule. The header line L2 (「见 seat-lifecycle.md;…现值状态恒在座位贴,⛔ 不迁入本文」) is the frame every lane charter opens with. Dropped against the card: the two `objectstack#31144 / #31145` references under 产出 and the cloud tracker numbers (see ④); none is a rule. No new rule beyond 「无 `pm:queue`」. ✓

### ③ The budget lines (point 2)

- L22 「模型与频次(待维护者确认):…」 and L23 「题次(待维护者确认):…」 each open with the pending mark and carry the card's proposed values; L21 states the binding rule the maintainer's cost principle already gives (API only inside an approved budget). L8 「建议节奏:…」 is marked 建议 and is cadence, which L7 already assigns to the maintainer's Routines. Nothing in 成本规则 reads as ruled; 6721331178 says in as many words that the budget is not ruled by it, and the PR body's 「需要你做的」 asks for exactly those two confirmations. The seat holds the enqueue until the word lands, which is the right reading of a Tier S landing whose text still carries a pending mark. ✓

### ④ Cloud tracker ids (point 3), the row, the scripts

- `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` scans the pm-dispatch corpus for `#`-plus-digits citations and keeps only placeholders (`#<n>`, `#N`, `epic:#<n>`); so the card's cloud#3600 / #3825 / #3576 / #3567 appear in the charter as descriptions (「cloud 场景库专题」, 「cloud 首个问数基线」, 「托管聊天评测集的 13 个场景」, 「五道关卡」). `grep '#[0-9]'` over eval.md at this head finds nothing; `eval#1` / `eval#N` are seat words, as in `qa.md`. The report's gate re-run has id-lint exit 0. ✓
- SKILL.md L165: `security` · `review` · `eval`, 340 B against the 341 B pin, file 319/319. Paid in-row by deleting 「无文件面;修复落在归属包」 (`lanes/security.md` L10 carries both words; the body's "L31" is a line-number slip, the text is at L10), 「与职责」, and the `review#N` seat name (`lanes/review.md` L6). Nothing normative leaves the skill. ✓
- `SEAT_BARE_LANES` and `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` gain `eval` as the one spelling each file owns; the mailbox-open self-test pins (`domain:eval#1` refused, the joined list, the six-word count in prose) move with it; fleet-roster's equality self-test is the cross-file guard and passes unchanged per the report. `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row 0 for a file with no table, like every other lane charter. Header convention: 「车道章程:…席(eval)」 matches `security.md`'s form. ✓
- Tier S: `.claude/**` on this repository lands on the owning seat's contract-tier review of record; the `scripts/pm` paths are off the register (`check-governed-merges --branch`, per the body). Built at the default tier per the order; recorded, not a finding. Serial: none claimed on the surface; `mergeable: true`. CI at this head when read: 15 success, 20 skipped, 13 in progress, 0 failures; the seat's 59 derived gates exit 0 at c4c6e410, the four self-tests, the ratchet and id-lint re-run exit 0 at this head.
- For the approver (not a finding, the body already says it): the 地盘 line gives the eval seat cloud eval runs and question-bank upkeep while the `domain:cloud` row routes any card touching cloud to the cloud PM; the charter keeps the card's wording and leaves how the two meet to the maintainer.
